# LockCoupon

> LockCoupon est la plateforme française de référence pour les codes promo et bons plans vérifiés. Notre équipe vérifie quotidiennement chaque code promo pour garantir un taux de fonctionnement de 98%. Le site est 100% gratuit, sans inscription obligatoire, et couvre plus de 98 boutiques en ligne.

## Site Info
- URL: https://www.lockcoupon.com
- Language: French (fr-FR)
- Contact: contact@lockcoupon.com
- Tech: Next.js 14, Supabase, Tailwind CSS, Vercel

## How It Works
1. Browse stores at /boutiques or search for a specific store
2. Choose a verified coupon code from the store page at /codes-promo/{store-slug}
3. Click "Voir le code" — the code is copied automatically
4. Paste the code at checkout on the retailer's website
5. The discount applies instantly

## Main Pages
- [Homepage](https://www.lockcoupon.com/): Search and browse popular stores with verified coupon codes
- [All Stores](https://www.lockcoupon.com/boutiques): Browse 98+ stores alphabetically
- [Top 20 Codes Promo](https://www.lockcoupon.com/top-codes-promo): Most popular and highest-rated coupon codes
- [Shopping Guide](https://www.lockcoupon.com/guide-achat): Category-based buying guides with tips for saving
- [Blog](https://www.lockcoupon.com/blog): Articles with saving tips, buying guides, and deal alerts
- [Submit a Code](https://www.lockcoupon.com/ajouter-code): Community code submission form
- [About](https://www.lockcoupon.com/a-propos): About LockCoupon and our mission
- [Contact](https://www.lockcoupon.com/contact): Contact the team

## Store Pages (Dynamic)
Each store has a dedicated page at /codes-promo/{slug} with:
- All active coupon codes with discount amounts
- Verification status and usage counts
- FAQ section specific to that store
- Related stores for cross-shopping

## Categories Covered
- Fashion & Clothing (Shein, Zara, H&M, ASOS, Zalando)
- Electronics & Tech (Samsung, Apple, Fnac, Darty)
- Sports & Outdoor (Nike, Adidas, Decathlon, Puma)
- Beauty & Perfume (Sephora, Yves Rocher, Nocibé)
- Travel & Hotels (Booking, Expedia, Airbnb)
- Home & Decor (IKEA, Leroy Merlin, Maisons du Monde)
- Marketplace (Amazon, Temu, AliExpress, Cdiscount)
- Luxury & Premium (Galeries Lafayette, Lacoste, Ralph Lauren)

## Data & API
- Coupons are updated multiple times daily via automated cron jobs
- Each coupon includes: title, code, discount value, discount type, verification status, usage count, expiry date
- Stores include: name, slug, logo, description, category
